## Objective
- Make the game’s map buildings look more recognizable and let players tap one to enter a distinct building screen.

## Requirements
- Build the requested change without asking clarifying questions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Added a custom interior screen for each facility type, with unique room descriptions and themed props.
- Added a “Back to Southside” control to return to the map.

## Work State
### Completed
- Updated map building drawings with visible walls, roofs, windows, doors, and facility-specific details.
- Added tap-to-enter navigation and facility management actions inside the interior screen.
- Added responsive interior styling.

### Active
- Validate the game in a browser, including map building taps, interior actions, and mobile layout.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Check JavaScript syntax and run the game.
2. Test tapping each building, returning to the map, and using collect/upgrade/resume actions inside.
3. Save and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot; fix any issues found.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Building rendering, tap navigation, interior screen rendering, and facility actions.
- `index.html`: Added the interior screen container.
- `styles.css`: Building interior layout, room visuals, and responsive styling.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted and have not yet been browser-tested.
